pages.text: Sends a GET request and returns the answer.$(br2)GET reads data. Redirects are followed, except from https to http. The results are those of the last answer. A status of 400 or higher raises HTTP_STATUS, and the results are delivered as well.

$(li)$(1)connection$() STRUCT c0de_net/http/HTTP_CONNECTION: the server$(li)$(1)endpoint$() STRING: the path behind the base endpoint (optional, default empty)$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the raw data of the answer$(li)result $(1)status$() INTEGER: the HTTP status, like 200
$(li)result $(1)headers$() HASH STRING: the headers of the answer, with lower-case names
$(1)CALL c0de_net/http/HTTP_GET$(br)  PARAMETER connection api ;$(br)  PARAMETER endpoint "/forecast?city=Berlin" ;$(br)  RESULT result answer$()
